name: UNIV 4611
title: Showcasing your Competencies: Crafting Pre-Health Applications, Part 1
description: First in a 2-part seminar series on the reflective and practical aspects of preparing for health professions applications. Key issues in the pre-health journey, emphasizing the articulation of values, motivations, strengths, and experiences.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required. Not open for credit to students who have passed UNIV 4610 or UNIV 3995 when offered as "Post-Baccalaureate Seminar: Preparing for Health Professions I," "Showcasing your Competencies: Crafting Pre-Health Applications, Part 1," or "Showcasing your Competencies: Crafting Pre-Health Applications." May not be taken out of sequence after passing UNIV 4612.
